decision: Plain inverted index in memory, no search service
why: 412 recipes fit in 300 KB; a hosted search adds a bill and a dependency for no measurable gain
The 5 reference routes disagree with each other by about 2%, so tighter isn't measurable

why: Each README is in its own repo, so the children can't write over each other
